title: AgainROM - a Golang open-source reimplementation of Rage of Mages (1998)
author: EugenPenguin
selftext:
Hello everyone!

I would like to share a project I have been working on for a while using Claude Code: an open-source reimplementation of Rage of Mages (1998), written in Go.

The project is an experiment with a full agent pipeline: agents investigate, research and reverse-engineer the game’s binaries, then build a free implementation from the specification that research produces. The goal is an engine that runs the original assets without bugs or significant behavior changes. It should also be cross-platform and moddable.

The pipeline consists of three major parts:

* an orchestrator: the only entry point for user <-> agent interaction
* research: a repository where all experiments on the original game are conducted; agents working there produce claims about the game
* implementation: the game engine repository, built from the claims that research produces

The key rules I follow:

* no game assets in any repository. This is an independent implementation that could become an engine for any game of the Rage of Mages family, and even for custom ones. Something like the OpenMW approach
* no goal of a byte-for-byte reimplementation; preserve the behavior, not the original code
* agents use no other implementations or format specifications, only our own research

How it is done:

* At first I used spec-driven development (SDD) heavily, but it turned out very expensive tokenwise and timewise. Currently a task is one agent, one short document and one review.
* I give the orchestrator tasks and track their status on a custom Kanban board
* I run the game from time to time to check that the behavior is correct. At the start I did this a lot
* The orchestrator can also run the original game (through Computer Use) to compare UI and behavior

What is done so far:

* almost the full Rage of Mages 1, without multiplayer, with minor behavior differences; every known one is listed in the repo
* almost full support of the original SAV format: saves from the original load in AgainROM, and the original game loads saves made in AgainROM
* partial Rage of Mages 2 support
* a modding surface
* a custom map editor for single-player maps

I have been working on this project for three months. I use Claude Code Max 20x, and I also used Codex Pro x20 until it became unusable. The pipeline is custom: research agents use Ghidra with their own scripts and Go tools, and no ready-made skills or reverse-engineering repos were used

You need your own copy of the game (for example GOG one); the repo ships no game files

The game can be run in Windows, MacOS and can be built for Linux as well

Repo link: [https://github.com/againrom/againrom-engine](https://github.com/againrom/againrom-engine)
